facts.label: Avatar
facts.value: İğde, a cotton picker spindle character

story: DCT Asistan runs the daily social post workflow for an agriculture business. I draft the day's post, it lands in the app waiting for approval, and one tap publishes it. Nothing ever goes out without a sign-off. That rule is load-bearing, not decorative.

The app opens on today's post: the media, the caption, the music, and two buttons — approve and publish, or request changes. The Bugün tab holds the day, Geçmiş holds the history, and the Asistan tab is a plain-Turkish chat. Access runs on per-account token links, so everyone only ever sees their own queue.

The assistant is relay-first by design. Routine questions get instant prepared answers, requests and ideas get an honest feasibility reply and are relayed to a human. No live language model, and it never publishes on its own. It is fronted by İğde, a cotton picker spindle character: only her tip and gear base turn, and her face speaks purely through expression.
tagline: Custom social media management assistant for my father's company.
title: DCT Asistan
